translations.web: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem; plotting to kill him on the way.
translations.bsb: to grant them a concession against Paul by summoning him to Jerusalem, because they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.
translations.kjv: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
